why_seated: Argonautica. Seated to characterise the DISTANCE-INHERITANCE class on the same nine-feature battery used for direct master-student pairs — monolingual Greek so the lexical features stay comparable. Homer to Apollonius is roughly five centuries with no possible contact; Hesiod is the same-period alternative source. Plato and Aristotle are deliberately NOT examined until both classes are characterised.

later_ruling: Round 33 (commit e4c14dcc5, 2026-08-30; recorded in the authorship notebook #1569 and the measurement register #1570) reclassed Homer to Apollonius from a neutral distance control to a distant CONSTRUCTED lineage — the Alexandrian poet claiming epic descent — and refuted the lexical battery the seats were first stored for. why_seated above is kept as written at storing.
